content.text: According to Ms. Yarrow, while many individuals recognize the Old Station as 'a somewhat melancholy, vacant structure,' she is optimistic that some will recall their experiences there, whether during their commutes or as witnesses to it welcoming evacuees and soldiers during World War Two.
Visitors will have the opportunity to explore the Old Station, a Grade-II listed building designed by Isambard Kingdom Brunel, which was shut down in 1965.
